headlines.title: Too young to be vaccinated for measles? Babies face growing threats from outbreaks
headlines.description: As measles outbreaks continue to soar, a new question has emerged: Should doctors give measles shots earlier to better protect babies?

headlines.title: St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital Helps Young Rodeo Champ
headlines.description: Thirteen-year-old Crosslyn Mooney has always felt right at home in the saddle, riding her horse Dolly, but everything changed in 2024 when a CT scan revealed a brain tumor. But with the help of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, the rodeo competitor didn’t let a cancer diagnosis stop her from getting back in the saddle. TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager shares her story, then, Marlo Thomas, the hospital’s national outreach director, discusses how St. Jude helps its young patients experience n

headlines.title: Avoid Overindulging at Thanksgiving With These Tips
headlines.description: If you always end up feeling more stuffed than the turkey, gastroenterologist Dr. Trisha Pasricha joins TODAY with ways to avoid overindulging at Thanksgiving. Tips include eating protein and fiber first, taking a 15-minute walk after the meal, and laying down on your left side if you did overeat.

headlines.title: GLP-1s Tied to Higher Breast Density, New Study Shows
headlines.description: Weight loss from GLP-1s may increase women’s breast density, according to new research from Mass General Brigham Cancer Institute. Dr. Elisa Port, breast surgery chief at Mount Sinai Health System, joins TODAY to break down the study’s findings and what women on these medications need to know.

headlines.title: Doctors warn that now is the time to take the flu shot as cases continue to soar across the country
headlines.description: Flu cases are surging far earlier than usual, with New York City reporting a 300% jump in infections and a nearly 700% rise in hospitalizations. The CDC counts 2.6 million illnesses nationwide this season. NBC News' Sam Brock spoke to providers who say now is the time to get the shot ahead of the holidays.

headlines.title: As the US Loses Measles Elimination Status, These 7 Childhood Illnesses Could Also Come Back, Doctor Says
headlines.description: The U.S. lost its measles elimination status. An infectious disease doctor reveals what that indicates about the spread of other childhood illnesses as vaccination rates drop.
